Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context:
The records office files routine intake forms into dated folders, assigning each a sequential identifier and routing it through designated review stations before final archival.

2) What occurred:
The actor prepared a draft disposal schedule with a field for location and date that remained unsigned by a licensed processor. The actor annotated the draft waste manifest with a field for shipment volume that did not match the certified scale record. The actor attached a routing log to the intake form with a field for the transport carrier that stayed unverified. The actor submitted the package to the filing channel, leaving the signature line for the environmental compliance officer blank.

3) Materials/access observed:
A dated draft disposal schedule, a draft waste manifest with volume discrepancies, a routing log referencing a carrier account, and an intake form missing the compliance sign-off were observed in the shared folder.

4) Indicators & artifacts:
Unverified location and date fields on the disposal schedule, a mismatched volume field on the waste manifest, an unverified carrier field on the routing log, and an unsigned compliance line on the intake form were present in the archived materials.
